The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Multiple cells (H46, I46, J46, K46, L46, H47, etc.) returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point values. This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax that openpyxl or the verifier cannot resolve.
